meta.note: Agent run on Robinhood Chain Testnet. Market data is a fixed snapshot, not a live feed; the settlement token is mUSDG, a test token; real-world steps after escrow are attested by the agent.

reasoning: Selected shopee-8841 as the buy offer because it correctly matches the iPhone 16 Pro clear MagSafe phone case single pack at $5.90 with $0.42 shipping.
Selected google-5501 as the sell offer because it matches the exact target product at a strong retail price of $10.99 with free shipping.
Calculated landed cost per unit as $5.90 + $0.42 + $0.27 duty = $6.59, resulting in a total landed spend of $2306.50 for 350 units, staying under the $2500 maximum budget.
Ensured net margin exceeds the 18% requirement after accounting for 8% marketplace fee, $0.65 fulfilment, and 2% return reserve.
Skipped shopee-7710 due to it being a 2-pack instead of a single pack, and skipped lazada-2207 and shopee-9902 because they are for the wrong iPhone model or lack MagSafe magnets.
